- Manage Blob Storage Cashier access. ([de37a10](https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/commit/de37a10fdabeaf1a2fc54ddebf2beec523f03a60))

### Fixes

- Verify storage release downloads. ([10e4076](https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/commit/10e40763fdb5e2bdeeff2253f489da66995af641))
- Restore storage release downloads. ([aa2a61f](https://github.com/rabbithole-app/v2/commit/aa2a61f49a93bf2eaf248cb39c7ca26299265ef2))

## Wasm Verification

To rebuild the storage WASM module and verify its hash, run:

```sh
git checkout de37a10fdabeaf1a2fc54ddebf2beec523f03a60
npm install -g @icp-sdk/icp-cli@1.0.0 @icp-sdk/ic-wasm ic-mops@2.14.1
apps/backend/scripts/build-storage-release-wasm.sh
shasum -a 256 apps/backend/.icp/cache/artifacts/encrypted-storage
```

Expected storage WASM sha256: `31baf7d213645161bfeb05cccff0b3a5bf8a5bfb385578038b71d04ac3f85aac`

The machine-readable release contract is attached as `storage-release.json`.
